originalText:
Love.

Samsara is nirvana,
sound is mantra,
and all living beings are God.

It depends on how you look.
The world is nothing but how one sees it.
Seel Open your eyes and see!
Where is darkness?
- there is only light.
Where is death?
- there is only deathlessness.
